modern: How does the ruling faculty make use of itself? For everything lies in this. But everything else, whether it is in the power of your will or not, is only lifeless ashes and smoke.

explained.summary: The question that matters most is how your mind uses itself: how you judge, choose and respond. Everything depends on that. Everything else, whether it’s in your control or not, is just lifeless ash and smoke by comparison. For Marcus, the quality of your own thinking and choosing is the only thing of real worth.
